info.summary: The money behind the machine, as static JSON.
info.description: Static files written by the DeepStack site build (generated 2026-10-09T04:55:21Z). No key and no rate limit; every object carries its canonical url, generatedAt and the line "Analysis and opinion, not investment advice.". GitHub Pages serves every file with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so a browser can read the API from any origin; no CORS configuration exists or is needed for these static files. The same content is available to agents over the Model Context Protocol at https://mcp.deepstack.ltd/mcp, documented at https://deepstack.ltd/mcp/.
